card.name: Thresholds before blood count numbers
card.fires_on: The small word or symbol (than, <, a space, a decimal point) right before a number in a blood cell count threshold, such as lymphocyte or leukocyte counts. It also appears before a dose number.

modes.label: Count cutoffs
modes.description: Linking word or sign just before the number in a low blood count cutoff.
modes.example: hematocrit less than 45%, platelets less than 400 × 10 9 /L, and leukocytes less<< than>> 10 × 10

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The gap before a count or dose value such as 500 cells/mm3 or 375 mg/m2.

card.plain: It marks the spot just before a number in a blood count limit, like lymphocytes below 500.
